# Basketball-Reference.com

> > Comprehensive basketball statistics database covering NBA, WNBA, and ABA player profiles, team history, advanced metrics, and game logs.

Basketball-Reference.com is the authoritative source for basketball statistics, featuring detailed player profiles (including stars like Nikola Jokić, Victor Wembanyama, and Kawhi Leonard), historical data, and advanced analytics. The site provides tools like Stathead for deep statistical analysis and maintains comprehensive glossaries of basketball metrics including BPM, PER, and other advanced statistics.

## Key Topics

- NBA statistics and player profiles
- WNBA and ABA historical data
- Advanced basketball metrics (BPM, PER, Win Shares)
- Stathead statistical analysis tools
- Game logs and recent performance data
- Player career statistics and draft information
- Team history and franchise records
- Basketball terminology and stat definitions
- NBA teams (Lakers, Spurs, Clippers, Knicks, Timberwolves)
- Current NBA stars (Nikola Jokić, Victor Wembanyama, Kawhi Leonard, Anthony Edwards)
- Basketball glossary and metrics documentation
- Player database and search functionality
- Season-by-season statistics
- Shooting percentages and efficiency ratings

## Getting Started

- [Basketball Statistics & History of Every Team & NBA and WNBA Players](https://www.basketball-reference.com/): Homepage for NBA, WNBA, ABA stats and player/team history database
- [Glossary](https://www.basketball-reference.com/about/glossary.html): Definitions of NBA stats including BPM, advanced metrics, and terminology

## Player Profiles

- [Nikola Jokić Stats, Height, Weight, Position, Draft Status and more](https://www.basketball-reference.com/players/j/jokicni01.html): Nikola Jokić career stats, game logs, and Denver Nuggets player profile
- [Victor Wembanyama Stats, Height, Weight, Position, Draft Status and more](https://www.basketball-reference.com/players/w/wembavi01.html): Victor Wembanyama stats, game logs, and San Antonio Spurs player profile
- [Kawhi Leonard Stats, Height, Weight, Position, Draft Status and more](https://www.basketball-reference.com/players/l/leonaka01.html): Kawhi Leonard stats, game logs, and LA Clippers player profile
- [Anthony Edwards Stats, Height, Weight, Position, Draft Status and more](https://www.basketball-reference.com/players/e/edwaran01.html): Anthony Edwards career stats and Minnesota Timberwolves player profile
